text:
Maya K: Quick feedback loop on the new compact compare mock (figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZ). Main asks: make density discoverable, avoid ambiguous "perf" labels, and tighten the version-lock affordance.

Tom S: Agree on labels. Users read "perf" as subjective. Recommend explicit chips: "Latency (ms)", "Cost ($/1k)", and an optional "Throughput (req/s)". Tooltips should show p50/p90 + sample token cost.

Ivy L: Density idea: replace binary toggle with three-presets pill group (Comfortable / Compact / Dense). Show a tiny preview on hover that changes row height using CSS vars (no DOM reflow). Example:
```
:root{--row-h:64px}
[data-density=compact]{--row-h:44px}
.row{height:var(--row-h)}
```
This preserves virtualization.

Ravi P: Locking: current pin icon is ambiguous. Proposal: rename to "Lock version in comparison" and on click open a small confirm popover with scope selector (Local / Apply to all). Default to Local. Show undo snackbar. Also encode locks in the share link: `?compare=ids:1,2,3&locks=2:local`.

Maya K: Accessibility nits: badges at 12px fail contrast. Use bold 600 weight or darker hex, and make badges keyboard-focusable with `aria-describedby` pointing at the tooltip. For screen readers, tooltip text should read "Latency, p90 210ms".

ux-bot: Feature flag `compact_compare_presets_v1` created in staging. Use `/ff compact_compare_presets_v1 on`.

Tom S: Microcopy tweak: use "Lock version" (verb) not "Pinned" (status) in buttons. Snackbar copy: "Version locked for this comparison. Undo".

Ivy L: Small mobile note: collapse metrics to a single labeled chip "L:85ms" with chevron to expand details. Tap targets >=44px. Use a popover (role=dialog) for lock confirm on mobile.

Ravi P: I'll add telemetry: `compare.density_change`, `compare.lock`, `compare.lock_undo`, `compare.share_with_locks`. Will implement URL encoding + localStorage fallback for filter persistence.

Maya K: Perfect. Plan: ship behind flag, 1-week canary, then run accessibility pass. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to finalize copy. :white_check_mark:
